read.title: A+ Content Update for Snail Essence
read.text:
Team,

Our new A+ content for the snail essence was rejected for including a customer review quote. Amazon's guidelines do not allow reviews or quotes in A+ modules.

Please remove the quote from the third module and swap it for an ingredient image that highlights the 92% snail mucin. We should also add a comparison chart so shoppers can see the differences between our three essences.

Please send the revised design by Thursday so we can resubmit it before the holiday sale.

Thanks,
Minsu
